payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP array stores min cost for first i trips; two-pointer technique to find optimal previous trip for 90-min and 1440-min tickets.
payload.rationale: Solution uses DP with dp[i] = min(dp[i-1]+20, dp[p90-1]+50, dp[p1440-1]+120) where p90 and p1440 are monotonic pointers. This is classic 1D DP with linear state and amortized O(1) transitions per step.
